event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,520 parameters at 99.120000%, a +0.120000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 70 prior macro-attempts in this family and 621 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0172/micro-0020 at 1,520 parameters and 99.12%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0171/micro-0013 (FF-output pair 236/180 discarded at 98.98%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 89 and 91, values 0.0073292945 and 0.0081999823 (difference 8.707e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,519 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 8.829e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
